subject.title: Require Codex scan artifact coverage proof

question: Should ClawHub enforce fail-closed `artifact_coverage` on benign Codex scan worker outputs after the zero-byte verifier bug and branch conflicts are fixed?
rationale: This changes the authoritative ClawScan trust boundary and can make existing benign worker/model outputs fail closed, so maintainer security-boundary intent is required beyond the mechanical verifier repair.

options.title: Accept after repair
options.body: Fix the zero-byte range case, refresh the branch, and enforce coverage proof as the new benign-worker contract.

options.title: Stage compatibility first
options.body: Keep current behavior as the default while adding diagnostics or a dry-run mode before fail-closed enforcement.

options.title: Pause enforcement
options.body: Keep this draft paused or replace it with a narrower contract-design item until maintainers settle the permanent worker-output contract.

recommendation.title: Accept after repair
recommendation.body: Fix the zero-byte range case, refresh the branch, and enforce coverage proof as the new benign-worker contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main work has changed the same ClawScan worker and scan-request paths that would absorb this contract.
